name: delivery
description: Define the product, contract it, then navigate it to shipped. DEFINE: brief, PRD with MVP staging, architecture, with research, evidence-graded personas, simulated interviews and journeys, and a design system as optional depth. CONTRACT: a risk-first roadmap and self-contained stories with acceptance criteria and derisking spikes. NAVIGATE: the plan becomes beads, sprints are built by dedicated builders (or handed to your own runner, such as superpowers), reviewed independently and re-aligned. An adversarial challenge panel at every gate; a shipping team of role sessions (Chief of Staff, Product Manager, Delivery Manager, builders), each on the model its work needs.
